group.title: A software release briefing
group.passage: M1: Thank you for joining the release briefing. The new version of our scheduling application is ready, but we will not make it available to every customer today. First, fifty volunteer businesses will use it for one week while our support team monitors any problems. Their existing appointments will remain visible, and they can switch back to the previous version at any time. The main change is a shared availability view, which lets several staff members compare their calendars without opening separate windows. We have removed the proposed automatic billing feature from this release because it needs more testing. After the briefing, please review the customer help article and report any unclear instructions to the documentation team by four o'clock.
group.passageZh: 謝謝參加發布簡報。新版排程應用程式已就緒，但今天不會向所有客戶開放。先開放給五十家自願參加的商家試用一週，由客服團隊追蹤問題。既有預約仍可見，隨時可切回舊版。主要改變是共用空檔檢視，多名員工不必開不同視窗就能比較行事曆。原先規劃的自動計費功能需要更多測試，所以這一版不會推出。簡報後請讀客戶說明文章，最晚四點把不清楚的說明回報給文件團隊。
